notes.title: PC Master Aim v1.2 – Massive Update is LIVE!
notes.notes:
I'm back with a huge update that takes PC Master Aim to the next level. Version 1.2 is here with major improvements across the board – better compatibility, slicker visuals, and a smoother experience!

[h1]Here’s what’s new in v1.2:[/h1]

[h2]Universal Compatibility[/h2]
PC Master Aim is now fully compatible with ALL games.
Thanks to a new forced topmost window algorithm, your crosshair will always stay on top, even above other overlay apps. Nothing gets in its way – guaranteed.

[h2]Complete GUI Overhaul[/h2]
Buttons glow, animations feel alive, and every interaction is smoother. Your crosshair tool just got a premium makeover.

[h2]Enhanced Rendering for Designer[/h2]
A new and improved rendering algorithm has been implemented, giving your custom designs a much more polished and refined look. Crosshairs now appear cleaner and scale more accurately, making the designing experience smoother and sharper than ever.

[h2]Animation[/h2]
Spice up your aim with fully customizable crosshair animations!
Adjust speed and intensity to your liking – go subtle or go flashy, it’s all under your control.

[h2]Bug Fixes & Polish[/h2]
Several bugs have been fixed, including the one where the crosshair would pulse when holding the Right Mouse Button with toggle selected on click – this shouldn’t happen, and now it doesn’t. 
Page buttons also got a fluid animations – no more stiff or laggy clicks. It feels as smooth as it looks.

notes.title: PC Master Aim v1.1 is now available!
notes.notes:
[h1]PC Master Aim v1.1 has officially launched with some major improvements and new features that will enhance your crosshair customization experience! Here’s a breakdown of what's included:[/h1]

[b]1. Complete Design Page Overhaul[/b]
The design page has undergone a full transformation, now featuring two sections. The base layer is split into fully customizable lines, center dot, and outlines, alongside the original pixel drawer. Everything you need is now in one place for easier navigation.

[b]2. Hotkeys for Crosshair Adjustments[/b]
I’ve added hotkeys that let you toggle the visibility, the size, position, glow, and rotation of your crosshair with ease. Customize on the fly without needing to navigate through menus., Just press a key!

[b]3. Saved Customization Settings[/b]
Your customization settings are now saved, so you won’t have to reset them every time you open the app. Once you adjust your crosshair, it’s good to go for your next session.

[b]4. Quality of Life Improvements[/b]
This update includes a range of quality of life upgrades:

[list]
[*] Expanded Size Range: Adjust your crosshair to a wider range of sizes for more flexibility. 
[*] Improved Fonts: Enjoy a cleaner, more readable font throughout the app.
[*] Background Fixes: The hexagon patterns in the background have been fixed for a smoother visual experience.
[/list]

[b]5. Bug Fixes[/b]
Minor bugs have been resolved, including the issue where the browse icon was not illuminating correctly, ensuring a more stable experience.

And there's much more on the horizon! Stay tuned for future updates and new features coming soon.

notes.title: Glorious PC Master Aim Announcement #1
notes.notes:
[b]Announcement #1:[/b] PC Master Aim – The Ultimate Crosshair Overlay Experience is Here!

Gamers, the time has come to level up your aiming skills like never before! PC Master Aim has undergone a complete transformation, bringing you an all-new design, revolutionary features, and an experience worthy of the PC Master Race. This isn’t just an update; it’s a rebirth—crafted from scratch with innovation, precision, and YOU in mind.

The completely redesigned app now features a sleek, modern GUI focused on seamless usability. Navigate with ease and enjoy more features, with sections now displayed in full pages instead of cramped mini slides! The former Select Page is now split into two dedicated pages: Select and Design, each with enhanced functionality. The Design page includes a color picker wheel, a 64px expanded draw box, a grid system, and essential tools like a clear button and straight-line drawing mode. Additionally, the cursors dynamically change to match actions such as drawing or erasing, providing a polished and precise user experience.

But that’s not all—the Aim Trainer has received a complete overhaul. What once only calculated reaction time now provides a comprehensive suite of tests and training modules, measuring speed, precision, accuracy, and more. This isn’t just a tool; it’s your personal trainer, tailored to help you dominate every battlefield.

The PC Master Race demands excellence, and PC Master Aim delivers. Update now and claim your throne!
